Iconic EQ Machine Gun (w/ Bipod, Long Scope, Power Rebuild, & Smartgun Link). Holds 60 rounds. Fired using the Heavy Weapons Skill, is fired in Single Shot on the Marksman Rifle Range Table, and has Autofire (Machine Gun 4) and Suppressive Fire. All ammunition it fires also functions as Explosive Ammunition excluding its -2 Attack Check Penalty. Has a Minimum Autofire Multiplier of (x2), and requires 2 Actions to Reload. Requires BODY 10+ to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded and not Mounted, and BODY 12+ when fired for its user to not suffer the Torn Muscle Critical Injury.

Variant of: MA70 HB
Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Class: EQ Machine Gun
Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
